rules.statement: The Court has an inherent jurisdiction to restore a Proctor's name to the Roll of Proctors after it has been removed, provided that the person has expiated their offense and redeemed their character.
rules.supporting_quote: "There is no question that this Court has an inherent jurisdiction in the exercise of its discretion where it is of opinion that an offender has subsequently expiated his offence to restore him to the roll of practising members of the profession."

meta.parties: In the Matter of An Application By W.P.A. Wickeremesinghe To Be Restored To the Roll of Proctors
